title: Chips can survive the space environment — can their financing? | TechCrunch
summary: That’s unlikely until SpaceX can fly its Starship rocket in a fully reusable configuration. Even with Starship, however, SpaceX — as well as startups like StarCloud, Cowboy Space Corporation, Sophia Space, Orbital, and others — will need to buy chips.
